'''Hka'ka''' were a nocturnal [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. Preying upon the [[vsst]] species, hka'ka were the staple of the [[shenbit bonecrusher]]s which roamed the world.
